data.title: Messi returns but Miami knocked out of Leagues Cup
data.description: MIAMI - Lionel Messi made an emotional return on Wednesday following his father’s death and hints at retirement, but it wasn’t enough for his Inter Miami side who were knocked out of the Leagues Cup in a 3-2 loss to Mexico’s Leon.

data.title: US lawmakers demand inquiry into conditions on aircraft carrier
data.description: WASHINGTON - Congressional Democrats demanded answers on Wednesday about conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln, following reports of food shortages, broken plumbing and mental health crises during the aircraft carrier’s record-setting deployment.

data.title: Bangkok hotels see higher occupancy with lower room rates and revenue
data.description: Bangkok’s occupancy rose while ADR and RevPAR fell in the first half of 2026; Phuket raised room rates despite declines in occupancy and air-traveller numbers.

data.title: Matthew McConaughey makes sweet return to the big screen
data.description: LOS ANGELES - Matthew McConaughey had plenty of reasons to select “The Rivals of Amziah King”, a honey-themed thriller set in the American Southwest, for his return to the big screen after more than five years away.

data.title: South Korea’s blind fortune-tellers eclipsed by AI
data.description: SEOUL - Clients have drifted away from Song Oh-soon’s fortune-telling village on the edge of Seoul, preferring online AI-powered divination to the centuries-old prophesying tradition still practised there.

data.title: Government-wide password resets ordered after data leak
data.description: <p>The government has ordered staff of more than 300 departments to reset passwords immediately and inspect 30,000 systems to prevent further state data leaks.</p>

data.title: ‘Imposing ignorance’: US climate science under siege
data.description: WASHINGTON - A benchmark US report on the fast-changing state of the Arctic has been cancelled. The nation’s top research body has removed a chapter on global warming from a reference manual for judges.

data.title: Astronomers discover new ‘black hole star’
data.description: PARIS - Astronomers announced on Wednesday that they had discovered a new type of astronomical object called a "black hole star", potentially solving a mystery involving strange red dots spotted in the early universe.

data.title: D-Day for Farage and Count Binface in UK poll
data.description: LONDON - Voters in eastern England head to the polls on Thursday for a by-election triggered by hard-right Reform UK leader Nigel Farage, but amid a boycott by mainstream parties his main rival is a joke candidate called Count Binface.

data.title: Grieving Messi unsure about playing on 'much longer'
data.description: BUENOS AIRES - Lionel Messi said he has "serious doubts" about continuing to play football for "much longer" after the death of his father Jorge, in an emotional tribute posted on social media Wednesday.

data.title: Businesses welcome drive against red tape
data.description: The private sector has welcomed the government's accelerating efforts to remove laws and regulations that hamper business, saying the initiative would sharpen the country's competitiveness.

data.title: Flood risks push up southern double-track rail budget
data.description: The State Railway of Thailand (SRT) has raised the budget for its southern double-track railway projects by 17% after flood risks and construction costs increased.

data.title: Blue plates for EVs ‘to aid emergency response’
data.description: The Ministry of Transport will introduce blue number plates for electric vehicles by the end of this year, with the colour intended to improve emergency response.

data.title: People’s Party takes flak over handling of abuse
data.description: Activists working to combat gender-based violence have called on the People's Party (PP) to apologise to former MP Tisana Choonhavan over its handling of her sexual abuse allegations and launch an independent investigation into the case.

data.title: Grieving Argentine icon Messi unsure about playing on 'much longer'
data.description: BUENOS AIRES (ARGENTINA) - Lionel Messi said he has "serious doubts" about continuing to play football for "much longer" after the death of his father Jorge, in an emotional tribute posted on social media Wednesday.

data.title: Thai champs handed Pot 1 seeding for ACL draw
data.description: Buriram United have been placed in Pot 1 for the Eastern Zone of the AFC Champions League Elite, the Asian Football Confederation confirmed, ahead of an official draw on Aug 18 that will shape the continent's premier club competition.

data.title: ONE Championship: Nico Carrillo fires back at Superbon – ‘he talks too much’
data.description: Nico Carrillo has questioned why Superbon keeps criticising him as talk grows of a champion-versus-champion fight in ONE Championship.

data.title: Firms welcome govt bid to scrap red tape
data.description: The private sector has welcomed the government's accelerating efforts to remove laws and regulations that hamper business, saying the initiative would sharpen the country's competitiveness.

data.title: Missing German man found dead
data.description: PHUKET: The body of a 30-year-old German tourist who went missing after being swept out to sea at Freedom Beach has been found.

data.title: Lion café probed over bitten tourist
data.description: PHUKET: The Tourist Assistance Centre (TAC) has inspected a lion café following social media reports that a Chinese tourist was bitten by a lion.
